test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following designations of sheets with their respective trimmed sizes in length and breadth.

Designation Trimmed Size

A) A0 P) 297 × 420

B) A1 Q) 420 × 594

C) A2 R) 594 × 841

D) A3 S) 841 × 1189
solution:
The correct answer is __A-S ; B-R ; C-Q ; D-P__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A0__ trimmed size is 841 × 1189 mm.
 
• __A1__ trimmed size is 594 × 841 mm.
 
• __A2__ trimmed size is 420 × 594 mm.
 
• __A3__ trimmed size is 297 × 420 mm.
 
• The sizes reduce by half when moving from one designation to the next (e.g., A0 to A1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **ISO 216 Standard:**

 
 
• The A-series paper sizes are defined by the ISO 216 standard.
 
• The aspect ratio is always 1:√2, which allows easy scaling.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Different Sizes:**
 
 
• A0 is used for technical drawings and posters.
 
• A1 is commonly used for flip charts.
 
• A2 is used for medium posters and architectural drawings.
 
• A3 is popular for brochures, diagrams, and presentations.
